title: Concept: CORS exposes every response header to any origin
description: A CORS policy exposes every response header to the reading origin. The header is easy to set to a wildcard while diagnosing a client and is rarely narrowed again; custom headers frequently carry tenant or trace information that the API never intended a third-party origin to read.
applicability: HTTP APIs that answer cross-origin reads.
risk: Response metadata readable by any permitted origin; LOW severity.
